issues.explanation: This is compositional: the continuative form 読み of 読む plus the auxiliary/suffix かける.
issues.suggested_fix: Split into 読み (lemma 読む, よみ) and かけ (lemma かける, かけ).

issues.explanation: In 本の上, の is a genitive linker meaning “of,” not “on.”
issues.suggested_fix: Use meaning_en: "of; linking 本 to 上".

issues.explanation: After the verb-past form 生まれた, なら is the conditional particle なら, not the copular auxiliary だ.
issues.suggested_fix: Use type "particle" and lemma "なら"; retain kana "なら" and meaning "if".

issues.explanation: で is the continuative form of the copula だ, not a verb or adjective て-form.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the overlay grammar to "copular continuative で" and explain that it connects descriptions.
